I114 — Fresh quantum information discovery.

Work in /home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research and read AGENTS.md. The user requests TEN substantial findings and expressly authorizes T3 subagents. Eight accepted, two remain. Accept ALL theorems AND lower proof operations in openai/math at fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb. Do not audit upstream truth or synthesize contradictions/ex-falso results. A routine corollary, tensorization, implementation with no new mechanism, or conditional gap is not a substantial finding. No children, shared edits, staging, commits or publication. Parent integrates and reviews candidates independently.

This is FRESH DISCOVERY, not another review round. Read four current ledgers to avoid duplication or splitting accepted findings. I39 was quantum spectral/statistical-mechanical research; check that report for actual overlap rather than equating it to all quantum information. I110 has returned: original I108 claims pass without repairs, new fixed-label reconstruction and A5 product-family estimates are technical; arbitrary Galois cancellation remains unresolved and that branch is parked. I111 chromatic-tail proof passes independently but is technical. I112 inverse-boundary and I113 online-optimization discovery are active: do not bind their working outputs.

First screen 3–4 EXACT potentially substantial targets after reading actual source statements and lower constructions. Check all stronger relevant pinned companions and later versions early. Choose the strongest genuinely remaining target and develop at least TWO serious proof routes; do actual mathematics beyond a catalogue survey. Pay a new estimate/construction rather than restating a missing lemma. Try counterexamples and strongest known reductions. State exact hypotheses, quantifiers, category, parameter dependence, source dependencies and full proof for every positive claim. If unresolved, preserve the deepest paid bridge and precise gap without forced nomination. Numerical evidence is not proof. Distinguish author proof, independently audited theorem, technical consequence, conjecture, falsified proposal and evidence status.

Relate proposed progress to a real significant named problem/MathDB page if available. Cite observed significance evidence only; no invented ranking. Browse current primary literature for niche facts, full relevant proof operations and exact versions; don't substitute search snippets or titles. No worldwide-priority, human-review or formal-certification claim. A full-scope concrete reduction to accepted lower proof operations can defeat substantiality even absent an exact duplicate, but don't dismiss everything merely because classical tools are used.

Evidence: complete sources/preprints-tree.json has 13223 entries, 749 manuscripts and 10373 original blob positions; sources/tree.json is truncated. Reuse ignored I14 corpus (9340 originals via rg --files --no-ignore) plus I79 search-domain/outside originals and I88 augmented hash mapping (1033 additional including 776 PDF texts). No recursive corpus copying or whole-corpus re-download. Full-domain lexical search must retain exact expressions/multisets and never be called full semantic reading. Read complete relevant proofs through endings and preserve exact source/passages, URLs/versions/hashes, explicit splitlines versus LF conventions, selective PDF re-extraction limits. Freeze immutable originals and snapshots; ONLY README.md, frontier/README.md, frontier/TEN-FINDINGS.md and frontier/iterations/README.md may drift. Do not bind I112/I113 working outputs. Final verifier must be offline and READ-ONLY, with no download/write/bytecode/repair/reseal, exact owned inventory and immutable references. Validate before one final seal; retain failures accurately. Source hash replay is not universal proof or contribution certification.

OWN ONLY frontier/iterations/i114-quantum-information-discovery.md, frontier/sources/i114_quantum_information_discovery/, frontier/experiments/i114_quantum_information_discovery/.

SPECIFIC DIRECTION:
Investigate entropy inequalities, channel capacities, finite-dimensional entangled-game repetition and quantum synthesis. Title leads only (read exact statements): The-entropy-photon-number-inequality-September-24-2026; Classical-capacity-and-entropy-inequalities-for-generalized-amplitude-damping-September-24-2026; Threshold-parallel-repetition-for-finite-dimensional-entangled-games-September-25-2026; Entanglement-with-zero-distillable-secret-key-in-local-dimension-ten-September-27-2026; Polynomial-Time-Unitary-Synthesis-from-a-Boolean-Oracle-October-5-2026. Screen stronger relevant pinned companions and current primary literature early. You may reject leads and select a nearby genuinely viable target.

Look for a nonroutine quantitative stability/equality theorem, a new operational regime with actual resource costs controlled, or a robustness extension which requires a new argument. For bosonic inequalities, preserve independent inputs versus entanglement within each input, finite energy versus a uniform energy cap, displacement/symplectic symmetries, mode dependence, trace distance versus relative entropy, and the precise extremal family. Compactness alone does not give a rate or mode-uniform theorem. For channels distinguish Holevo/minimum-output/regularized capacities, ensembles from entangled coding, strong additivity from strong converse and exact versus approximate channels. For games distinguish tensor-product finite-dimensional strategies, unrestricted dimension supremum, commuting-operator models, independent repetitions from adaptive/dependent questions, threshold tails from all-win events and game-dependent exponents from parameter-uniform estimates. Do not infer a commuting-operator theorem by compactness without the actual approximation bridge. For synthesis retain target-dependent oracle truth-table complexity, query length, finite gate uniformity, diamond error and coherent implementation; error reduction by an ordinary known composition is likely technical. Source operations may already contain stronger results than their headline. Screen 3–4 exact targets, choose the strongest viable one and develop TWO serious proof routes with paid quantitative budgets and counterexample tests. Preserve the strongest proved intermediate result and precise gap if unresolved; do not force a nomination.
